wholePhysicalScope: The OSM node for Golden Rock and nearby mapped trail, two public-domain site photographs, and the nearby hotel environmental survey documenting the specific shrine dimensions.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the tilted gilded boulder, stupa, natural ledge and access.
limitations: The boulder crown, underside and support ledge use coarse native relief and visible profiles in the verified photographs. The horizontal extents and small railing elements are estimates.
The model covers the immediate shrine, deck and access only. Adjacent pavilions and the wider grounds are outside the mapped structure extent.
